title: 第168章 剑不是这么用的第167章 机关密布
content_zh:
白月都还没有看到第一个人偶是怎么动的，身体已经本能地向右偏了半寸。
一只木手擦着她的颈侧掠过，砸在了她原本所处的地板上，石制的地板硬是被它那木制的手砸出了一个坑。
白月瞳孔微缩，这人偶虽然没有真气，但它的攻击力完全不亚于一个古武者。
她转了个身，还没站稳，第二个人偶也悄悄摸到了她身后，它抬起手臂，手指张开，朝白月所在的方向拍下。
速度实在是太快了，呼啸声凌厉而至，白月甚至都来不及闪避，只得快速运转真气，用左肘硬挡了一下。但这一下，却让她觉得左侧手臂被震得生疼。
就算她早有准备，左侧手都已经提前被真气包裹，都依旧硬生生把她整个人震退了两步。
她后退的脚刚落地，第三个人偶的掌风也上来了，它从正前方劈下，五指微合，直取她的头颅。
白月看到后立刻俯身下蹲，朝右侧滑出半步，才刚拉开一点距离，第一个人偶的手掌又已经从侧面横劈过来，她没有硬接，借势往地上一滚，手撑地面的同时抬脚扫向第二个扑过来人偶的膝弯，动作利落干净，一气呵成。
第二人偶被她顺势扫趴下，一动不动，白月以为本可以少对付一个，结果一连串密集的嘎吱声响起，它又磕磕跘跘地站了起来！
白月偏不信邪，趁它还没完全站稳的空隙，提气就冲了上去，对着它的头颅就是一脚。
这一脚结结实实踢在它的脑门上，把它外表的木头都震成了碎屑，露出了大面积的金属框架。结果它也仅仅是往后倒了两步，上半身歪了一歪，很快又稳住了，抬起双手就要抓向白月的脚踝。
白月在空中翻身避开，侧身落地后顺势在地上滚了一圈，跟几个人偶再次拉开距离，稳住身形后，她单膝跪地，悄悄摸出了身上的龙鳞匕首。目光一直紧锁着那三个人偶，想观察他们到底是怎么动作的，为什么它们会动，为什么它们可以发挥出这么强的攻击力。
出乎意料的是，在白月观察期间，它们并没有任何动作，像是被人为地按下了暂停键，维持着最后的姿态动作僵立在原地。
白月的心中很是疑惑，她盯着三个人偶，就这样一动不动地对视了三分钟，它们还是没有动。
难道…白月心里突然有个大胆的猜想，她把龙鳞背在身后，慢慢起身。
果然！她刚起身，三个人偶都轻颤了一下，关节处发出细碎的摩擦声，像是又从休眠状态中被唤醒。
待白月站起来时，三个人偶同时出手，速度非常地快。
第一个人偶从左侧极速奔来，堵在了她的身后。
第二个从右侧欺身逼近，由掌变拳，直轰面门。
第三个已经在第二个人偶的后面准备好，以掌为刃，拦腰横斩。

三个人偶三面夹击，配合得天衣无缝，像是算好了白月所有的退路，没留下一个死角。
看着三个人偶的动作，白月屏了一口气，闭上眼，感受着空气中剧烈涌动的气流，做出了一个大胆的决定——她选择放弃所有的动作，站着不动。
就在第二个人偶一拳轰出，直落白月脑门上方的时候，它却忽然停住了，像静止了一般，停在距离白月脑门仅剩一个拳头的地方。
她心里直打鼓，但还是站直了身子。
赌对了。
白月站在它们中间，还能明显感觉到刚才三道攻击涌起的气流在她的身旁穿梭，但她没有动，她保持着目前静止站立的姿势，慢慢张开了双眼。
她现在终于有时间来研究一下这几个人偶了。
她刚刚一直在疑惑，为什么这些人偶会对她发起攻击，他们像是机器人，但又不完全像。
她一边被动反击，一边观察了它们的很多动作，都不像是被人为控制的，更像是根据你的动作，来激活它们原本设定中的一些反应。
看起来它们很智能，但其实也是有迹可循的。它们很擅长组合技，即一个打完另一个再跟上，这需要很高的默契配合度，但跟人类还是不一样。因为在空档期，他们是不会动作的。
如果是有思考性、有经验的人类，是根本不会给你预留这种空档期的。
白月猜想，它们就是几个被灌输了固定技能，通过某个介质，去感受和捕捉你的动作和反应的攻击型傀儡，这是一个很高明又很智能的设计，比后世那些机器人智能太多了。
但它们感知的介质又是什么呢？是什么物质在驱动它们，成为它们的动力呢？这总要符合一下能量守恒定律吧？不然不科学。
白月开始观察这些人偶，既然整个密道都有那么多的机关，那么它们会不会也有机关的开关键呢？
她的视线从面前人偶的手掌开始游走，沿着它的小臂向上移动，直到全身，终于发现了问题。
这个人偶的关节缝隙处刻着一排符号，是由密文刻画的，字迹非常细小，被木质的纹理半掩着，不仔细看几乎会以为是木头的纹路。
而且密文的排列方式很奇怪，像是一个序列的一段。
白月又瞄向第一个人偶，发现它的肩胛处有一排符号，第三个人偶的胸口处也有一组符号。
她来回看了这三个人偶好几遍，发现三个人偶身上的符号好像都各自分散，但又能构成一个完整的回路。
从第一个人偶的手臂起始端开始，通过特定的排列顺序串联到第二个人偶肩胛处的过渡段，最后在第三个人偶的胸口收尾，完成循环。

这是一个很精巧的闭环设计，像是一个命令序列被拆解成三段，分别存储在三个独立的载体上。
白月再次顺着这个思路把序列完整地推演了一遍，在收尾处看到了一个很有意思的符号。
content_en:
Bai Yue hadn't even seen how the first doll moved, and his body had already instinctively moved half an inch to the right.
A wooden hand brushed against the side of her neck and hit the floor where she was originally. The stone floor was forced into a crater by its wooden hand.
Bai Yue's pupils shrank. Although this doll had no true energy, its attack power was no less than that of an ancient warrior.
She turned around, but before she could stand still, the second doll quietly touched behind her. It raised its arm, spread its fingers, and took a picture in the direction of Bai Yue.
The speed was too fast, and the whistling sound came so fiercely that Bai Yue didn't even have time to dodge, so she had to quickly use her Qi to block it with her left elbow. But this time, she felt the shock to her left arm hurt.
Even though she had been prepared and her left hand had been wrapped in zhenqi in advance, it still knocked her back two steps.
As soon as her retreating feet hit the ground, the palm of the third doll also came up. It slashed from the front, its fingers slightly closed, and it went straight to her head.
Bai Yue immediately bent down and crouched down after seeing it, and slid half a step to the right. Just as she had opened a little distance, the palm of the first puppet was slashed from the side again. She did not catch it hard, but used the momentum to roll to the ground. While supporting the ground with her hands, she raised her foot and swept towards the knee of the second puppet that came over. The movement was neat and clean, all in one go.
The second doll was swept down by her and remained motionless. Bai Yue thought that there was one less person to deal with, but a series of dense creaking sounds sounded and it stood up again!
Bai Yue didn't believe in evil, so she took advantage of the gap before it could stand completely, rushed up with a boost of energy, and kicked it on the head.
This kick hit it firmly on the forehead, shattering the wood on its exterior to pieces, exposing a large area of ​​the metal frame. In the end, it only took two steps back, its upper body tilted, and then stabilized again. It raised its hands to grab Bai Yue's ankles.
Bai Yue turned over in the air to avoid it, landed sideways and rolled around on the ground. She distanced herself from the puppets again. After stabilizing her body, she knelt down on one knee and quietly took out the dragon scale dagger on her body. His eyes were fixed on the three puppets, trying to observe how they moved, why they moved, and why they could exert such strong attack power.
Unexpectedly, during Bai Yue's observation, they did not move at all. It was as if the pause button had been pressed artificially, and they remained frozen in place while maintaining their final posture.
Bai Yue was very confused. She stared at the three dolls and stared at each other motionlessly for three minutes, but they still didn't move.
Could it be... Bai Yue suddenly had a bold guess in her heart. She put the dragon scales behind her back and stood up slowly.
really! As soon as she stood up, the three dolls trembled slightly, and their joints made a small friction sound, as if they were awakened from a dormant state again.
When Bai Yue stood up, the three puppets shot at the same time, very fast.
The first doll came from the left at high speed and blocked her behind.
The second one approached from the right, changed his palm into a fist, and struck straight in the face.
The third one was already ready behind the second puppet, using his palm as a blade to cut across the middle.
The three puppets attacked from three sides and cooperated perfectly, as if Bai Yue had calculated all of Bai Yue's escape routes without leaving a single blind spot.
Watching the movements of the three puppets, Bai Yue took a breath, closed her eyes, felt the violent surge of air in the air, and made a bold decision - she chose to give up all movements and stand still.
Just when the second puppet punched out and landed directly on top of Bai Yue's head, it suddenly stopped, as if it was still, and stopped just one fist away from Bai Yue's head.
Her heart pounded, but she stood up straight.
The bet was right.
Bai Yue stood among them and could clearly feel the airflow from the three attacks just now passing through her body.Shuttle, but she did not move. She maintained her current standing still posture and slowly opened her eyes.
Now she finally had time to study these dolls.
She had just been wondering why these dolls were attacking her. They looked like robots, but not exactly like them.
While passively fighting back, she observed many of their movements. They didn't seem to be controlled by humans, but more like activating some of their originally set reactions based on your movements.
They seem to be very intelligent, but in fact there are traces to follow. They are very good at combo skills, that is, one beats the other and then follows up. This requires a high degree of tacit cooperation, but it is still different from humans. Because during the gap period, they will not move.
If you are a thinking and experienced human being, you will never reserve such a gap period for you.
Bai Yue guessed that they are just a few attack puppets that have been instilled with fixed skills to feel and capture your movements and reactions through a certain medium. This is a very clever and intelligent design, much smarter than those robots of later generations.
But what is the medium through which they perceive? What substance is driving them and becoming their driving force? This must comply with the law of conservation of energy, right? Otherwise it is unscientific.
Bai Yue began to observe these dolls. Since there were so many mechanisms in the entire secret passage, would they also have the opening and closing keys of the mechanisms?
Her eyes wandered from the palm of the puppet in front of her, up its forearm, to its whole body, and finally discovered the problem.
There is a row of symbols engraved in the gaps between the joints of this doll, which are written in cipher text. The writing is very small and half-hidden by the texture of the wood. If you don't look carefully, you might think it is the texture of the wood.
Moreover, the ciphertext is arranged in a strange way, like a section of a sequence.
Bai Yue looked at the first doll again and found a row of symbols on its shoulder blades, and a set of symbols on the chest of the third doll.
She looked back and forth at the three dolls several times and found that the symbols on the three dolls seemed to be scattered, but they could form a complete circuit.
Starting from the beginning of the first doll's arm, it is connected to the transition section at the shoulder blade of the second doll in a specific arrangement, and finally ends at the chest of the third doll, completing the cycle.
This is a very delicate closed-loop design, like a command sequence being disassembled into three segments and stored on three independent carriers.
Bai Yue once again followed this idea and deduced the sequence completely, and saw a very interesting symbol at the end.
